title: Room and House
author: Noor Lockridge
blurb: Sable Vane, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
